sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 negative: unreconciled target routes to exception queue
sys_atf_test.description: A request whose target does not reconcile to an authoritative IPAM/DDI-keyed identity must route to the reconcile-exception queue and must not close complete.

sys_atf_step.step_config_title: Service Catalog - Order the item with an unreconciled target
sys_atf_step.description: Order a Day-2 identity request whose target_user does not match a reconciled CI; capture the RITM.
Assert the request did NOT close complete - it must sit in the exception queue for a human, not actuate against an ambiguous identity (CM-8).
